commands.name: search
commands.detail: Filter events or transformed rows.

commands.name: where
commands.detail: Filter with comparisons, including null-propagating period concatenation such as first." ".last = full_name for String and number operands (use tostring(value) for Boolean), direct isnull/isnotnull predicates, match(value, "regex") substring predicates using a literal bounded RE2 pattern, like(value, "pattern") whole-string predicates using a literal bounded wildcard pattern, now() as the fixed search-start Unix second, relative_time(time, "specifier") as nullable Unix seconds after a bounded literal offset-and-snap program in the effective IANA search timezone, strftime(time, "format") in that timezone, or strptime(text, "format") as nullable Unix seconds.

commands.name: eval
commands.detail: Create or replace fields; the null-propagating period operator concatenates 2-32 String or number operands in source order, as in full_name=first." ".last (use tostring(value) for Boolean), if(predicate, true_value, false_value) selects between two values, coalesce(value, fallback, ...) selects the first non-null fixed value, case(predicate, value, ...) selects the value for the first true predicate, lower(value)/upper(value) map a Unicode string or multivalue, len(value)/length(value) count UTF-8 code points in one string, substr(value, start[, length]) selects UTF-8 code points with SQLite indexing and literal integer indexes, tostring(value) preserves strings, renders exact numbers, and uses capitalized Boolean text, round(value[, precision]) rounds a number with an optional literal precision from 0 through 18, ceil(value)/ceiling(value) rounds a number upward, floor(value) rounds it downward, mvcount(value) counts non-null multivalue members, a single value as 1, and no values as null, match(value, "regex") tests substring matches with a 4 KiB literal RE2 pattern, like(value, "pattern") tests whole-string matches with a 4 KiB literal wildcard pattern where % matches zero or more Unicode code points and _ matches one Unicode code point, now() returns the fixed search-start Unix second, relative_time(time, "-1d@d+2h") applies an optional signed offset, optional snap, and optional signed post-snap offset in the effective IANA search timezone and returns nullable Unix seconds from a 1 KiB literal specifier, strftime(time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%Q") formats canonical time or Unix seconds in that timezone using a bounded literal format, and strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N") requires a full date and returns nullable microsecond Unix seconds with a 4 KiB literal format and a 4 KiB String input ceiling. Formatted tostring modes and negative or calculated round precisions are not yet supported.

commands.name: rename
commands.detail: Rename one or more exact fields.

commands.name: fields
commands.detail: Include or exclude exact fields.

commands.name: table
commands.detail: Create an ordered statistics table.

commands.name: sort
commands.detail: Sort rows by exact fields.

commands.name: dedup
commands.detail: Keep the first row for each exact key.

commands.name: rex
commands.detail: Extract named fields with the supported RE2 subset.

commands.name: spath
commands.detail: Extract one typed scalar from an explicit JSON path.

commands.name: bin
commands.detail: Bucket one numeric or canonical time field with an explicit span.

commands.name: bucket
commands.detail: Alias of bin with an explicit span.

commands.name: head
commands.detail: Keep the first rows.

commands.name: tail
commands.detail: Keep and reverse the final rows.

commands.name: stats
commands.insertion: stats count AS events count(eval(status>=500)) AS errors c(user) AS user_occurrences dc(user) AS user_count values(user) AS users min(duration_ms) AS min_ms max(duration_ms) AS max_ms earliest(status) AS first_status latest(status) AS last_status p50(duration_ms) AS median_ms p95(duration_ms) AS p95_ms sum(bytes) AS total_bytes avg(duration_ms) AS avg_ms BY level
commands.detail: Aggregate with row count, true-only count(eval(predicate)) AS output, count/c field occurrences, dc/distinct_count, values, list, min, max, chronological earliest/latest, pN/percN percentiles (1-99), sum, and avg.

commands.name: eventstats
commands.insertion: eventstats count(eval(status>=500)) AS errors BY level
commands.detail: Add one row count, field-occurrence count, or true-only count(eval(predicate)) to every input row globally or within up to 16 exact BY fields.

commands.name: top
commands.detail: Find the most frequent values.

commands.name: rare
commands.detail: Find the least frequent values.

commands.name: timechart
commands.detail: Chart count, percentile, sum, or average over fixed time buckets; only count may split BY one field.

commands.name: chart
commands.insertion: chart count OVER status BY level
commands.detail: Build a bounded two-dimensional aggregate table.

functions.name: count
functions.detail: Count rows, matching predicates, or present field values.

functions.name: p50
functions.detail: Estimate the 50th percentile of non-null numeric field values.

functions.name: p95
functions.detail: Estimate the 95th percentile of non-null numeric field values.

functions.name: c
functions.detail: Alias for counting present field values.

functions.name: dc
functions.detail: Count distinct non-null field values.

functions.name: distinct_count
functions.detail: Alias for counting distinct non-null field values.

functions.name: values
functions.detail: Collect distinct non-null field values.

functions.name: list
functions.detail: Collect non-null field values in input order.

functions.name: min
functions.detail: Return the minimum non-null field value.

functions.name: max
functions.detail: Return the maximum non-null field value.

functions.name: earliest
functions.detail: Return the chronologically earliest field value.

functions.name: latest
functions.detail: Return the chronologically latest field value.

functions.name: sum
functions.detail: Sum non-null numeric field values.

functions.name: avg
functions.detail: Average non-null numeric field values.

functions.name: if
functions.detail: Select between two values using a predicate.

functions.name: case
functions.detail: Select the first value whose predicate is true.

functions.name: now
functions.detail: Return the fixed search-start Unix second.

functions.name: strftime
functions.detail: Format a time value with a supported literal format.

functions.name: strptime
functions.detail: Parse text with a supported literal time format.

functions.name: relative_time
functions.detail: Apply a bounded relative-time program.

functions.name: tonumber
functions.detail: Convert a supported scalar value to a number.

functions.name: tostring
functions.detail: Render a supported scalar value as text.

functions.name: replace
functions.detail: Replace bounded RE2 matches in a string.

functions.name: isnull
functions.detail: Test whether a value is null or missing.

functions.name: isnotnull
functions.detail: Test whether a value is present.

functions.name: coalesce
functions.detail: Return the first non-null argument.

functions.name: lower
functions.detail: Lowercase a string or multivalue.

functions.name: upper
functions.detail: Uppercase a string or multivalue.

functions.name: len
functions.detail: Count Unicode code points in a string.

functions.name: length
functions.detail: Alias for counting Unicode code points in a string.

functions.name: round
functions.detail: Round a number with an optional literal precision.

functions.name: ceil
functions.detail: Round a number upward.

functions.name: ceiling
functions.detail: Alias for rounding a number upward.

functions.name: floor
functions.detail: Round a number downward.

functions.name: mvcount
functions.detail: Count non-null multivalue members.

functions.name: match
functions.detail: Test a string against a bounded RE2 pattern.

functions.name: like
functions.detail: Test a string against a bounded wildcard pattern.

functions.name: substr
functions.detail: Select Unicode code points using literal indexes.

keywords.name: AS
keywords.detail: Assign an explicit output field name.

keywords.name: BY
keywords.detail: Group or split results by fields.

keywords.name: limit=
keywords.detail: Set an explicit bounded result count.

keywords.name: max_match=
keywords.detail: Set the bounded rex match count.
